name: Comcast
desc:
Remote Inbound Sales Representative (Voice) | $15.00/hour (non-negotiable) plus uncapped commission. Employees who meet sales performance targets earn $16,000 annually in commission, with the opportunity to earn more by exceeding targets
Company: Comcast
Industry: Telecommunications | Inbound Sales
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 This role has you answering inbound calls from customers and turning those conversations into sales, whether that's a new service, an upgrade, or an add-on. You're using a consultative approach, actually listening to what the customer needs, working through objections, and offering solutions that genuinely fit rather than just pushing a product.
Beyond the sales conversation itself, you're navigating Comcast's internal systems to process transactions accurately while keeping the pace up in what's described as a genuinely dynamic, fast-moving environment. You'll be expected to build real rapport quickly since these are one-off inbound calls, not an ongoing relationship, so making a strong first impression matters a lot here.

Hours of operation run 5:50am-11:15pm Central, 7 days a week, and you'll need genuine flexibility since your specific shift assignment isn't determined until after you're hired and complete pre-employment requirements.
wage: $15.00/hour (non-negotiable) plus uncapped commission. Employees who meet sales performance targets earn $16,000 annually in commission, with the opportunity to earn more by exceeding targets
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: High school diploma or GED.
 Required Experience: 0-2 years of relevant work experience.
 Preferred Experience: Not separately broken out.
 Required Skills:
Persuasion and consultative selling technique
Strong customer focus balanced with sales goals
Technical knowledge to navigate complex systems while on a call
Resilience and professional integrity
Critical thinking and problem-solving
Genuine flexibility for a variable schedule across a wide daily window, 7 days a week

Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
Someone who's naturally persuasive and enjoys turning a customer conversation into a sale
Participants who are comfortable with commission-based earning potential on top of a base wage
Anyone genuinely flexible with scheduling, since shifts span nearly 18 hours a day, every day of the week
People who want to build sales experience with a large, recognizable company
Not a Good Fit for:
Participants who need a fixed, predictable schedule known in advance, shift assignment happens only after hire
Someone who dislikes sales pressure or performance-based pay structures
Anyone with a criminal history directly related to financial dishonesty, see Coach Notes below, since Comcast is explicit that this could affect a conditional offer for this specific role
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Inbound sales
Consultative selling
Customer engagement
Objection handling
Sales targets and quotas
Product knowledge
Customer relationship building
Commission-based sales
Technical systems navigation
Telecommunications sales
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
Application
Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you.
If assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen.
If phone screen passes you can expect the final interview.
 Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3-15 days on average.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell me about a time you turned a customer's hesitation or objection into a completed sale.
How do you build rapport quickly with someone you're only speaking to once?
Describe your experience navigating a computer system while maintaining an engaging conversation.
How do you stay motivated with a commission-based pay structure?
What does genuine schedule flexibility look like for you, given this role could involve any shift across a nearly 18-hour daily window, 7 days a week?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $15.00/hr base pay (non-negotiable), plus uncapped commission. Employees meeting sales performance targets earn $16,000 annually in commission (Total Target Compensation of $22.69/hr), with potential to earn more by exceeding targets.
Shift: Full-time, remote. Hours of operation 5:50am-11:15pm Central, 7 days a week. Specific shift assigned after hire and completion of pre-employment requirements, must be flexible to work any assigned shift including nights, weekends, and overtime.
Benefits: Comcast's broader Total Rewards package including benefits designed to support physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing; specifics not detailed in this posting.
Equipment Provided: Yes
Felony Friendly?: Comcast states it will consider applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with Fair Chance laws. However, the posting also states federal, state, or local law may restrict Comcast from hiring people convicted of certain crimes, and a criminal history with a direct, adverse relationship to this specific job's duties could result in a conditional offer being withdrawn. Since this role involves processing sales transactions and customer account information, financial crimes (theft, fraud) would likely draw more scrutiny than for a general customer service role. Encourage honesty and confirm directly.
Drug Test: Not stated in posting.

Notes: This role's total compensation structure is worth explaining clearly to a participant: $15/hr guaranteed base, with realistic total earnings around $22.69/hr for someone hitting standard targets, but the base alone is fixed regardless of performance. The scheduling window here (6:50am-12:15am, 7 days a week) is unusually wide, even compared to other Comcast roles we've reviewed, make sure a participant's availability genuinely can flex that broadly before referring them. The named Fair Chance protections are specific to California cities/counties, Oklahoma isn't named, so don't assume the same formal protections apply locally.

Career Pathway: Inbound Sales Representative → Senior Sales Representative → Sales Team Lead → Sales Supervisor → Sales Operations Manager
training: Discussed in interview/offer stage. Must have availability to accept any shift and realize training may be a different set of hours than working shift.
